integrity: Exact algebraic proof with standalone reproducible rational tests; origin of motivating literature and limits are cited. This is a same-model assessment, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Optimality only for coordinate-permutation-exchangeable sign laws with universally unbiased affine correction using the known row-sum vector, with independent probes and squared Euclidean risk. Extra all-ones matvec is counted. No general algorithmic minimax or high-probability claim; specialist prior equivalence is possible.
title: Sharp parity transition for row-sum-corrected balanced-sign diagonal estimation
